title: A stalled job's log stays for 7 days.
ruling: Owner, page item 405 (stall-log-kept), pick a at 06:09 CST Nov 8: on a stall the watcher writes a marker beside the log; at job end the log stays if the marker is there and the beat file goes; the next stall-watch hook call removes marked logs older than 7 days; no timer runs. Options b (stop the job) and c (today's rule) were not taken.
